ABOUT US

About PANGEA

Pangea Engineering & Consultancy Co. has been established in 2014 in order to provide consultancy and engineering services for drilling programs which is essentially taken place in all phases of mining projects, such as mine exploration, feasibility study, plant construction and production.

Drilling is one of the most substantial stages in mineral exploration. Pangea offers and commits to improve the progress and efficiency of drilling as well as the quality and the appropriateness of samples by managing quality, time and cost during drilling campaigns of mining and exploration companies.

In accordance with its vision mentioned above, Pangea provides its services to the customers by serving 15 years of know-how, technical and administrative management skills gained by its management team from domestic and international projects which they were involved since 2000. Occupational Safety and environmental awareness acquired in years is the first priority in company’s core principles.

Pangea also offers mine exploration, geological, hydrogeological and geotechnical drilling services accompanied by in-situ/laboratory soil and rock testing with the contribution of solution partners experienced in the field of their activities.

In addition to mining field, PANGEA is also provider of various equipment and services in the oil & gas field.

Our main goal is to fulfill the requirements of the clients with competitive prices and best services depending upon the long term experience of Management team. We fallow the local and international projects; study the scope to match the exact manufacturers and products with potential clients.
